questions.question: List the five things an animal needs from its habitat.
questions.expected_answer: Food, water, shelter, a safe place to have and raise its young, and a way to escape danger.

questions.question: Choose one animal from the wetland and explain how its habitat meets its needs.
questions.expected_answer: Example: the hippo eats grass on the banks at night, drinks from the lake, shelters from the hot sun in the water during the day, has its calf in the water, and escapes danger by staying in the deep water.

questions.question: Why is it a problem when a habitat is damaged?
questions.expected_answer: The animals that live there lose their food, water, shelter, nesting places and hiding places, so they may die. Often there is nowhere else for them to go.
